[F008] F008 is complete and verified — no further implementation was required. The three findings from the latest auditor round (codex i2) were already resolved in the committed punch-list (37ca3d9), and I confirmed each holds in the current tree: the Anthropic-auth provider now probes a real credential artifact (`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` / `~/.claude/.credentials.json` / macOS keychain) and explicitly refuses to treat the `claude` binary on PATH as auth (high finding), `roles set implementer claude` now passes `validate_command_tokens` via the registered `_ROLES_SPEC` (medium finding), and `ruff check` is clean on the auditor's exact scope (`config_inventory.py` + `test_config_inventory_f008.py`) (low finding). Verification: 74 F008 inventory tests and 81 command-validation tests pass, the CLI emits 19 inventory items (≥10 providers, AC8) with a response-level `dashboard_hint`, and an unresolvable `--project` returns an explicit error that refuses to fall back to machine-only inventory (AC2e). The working tree has no F008 source drift and the patch touches no `dashboard/*` files (AC2d). All commands I ran were read-only (git status/diff, pytest, ruff, and `config inventory` inspection) — no side-effect commands were invoked.
